<thought>After reviewing the available functional groups and the description of the Doebner modification, the appropriate retrosynthetic template should break an aldehyde and a carboxylic ester (from malonic acid) and form a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic acid. I will search the template catalog for templates that match these functional‑group changes on a generic cinnamic‑acid‑type product (SMILES O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). This should return the template that reproduces the Doebner modification, from which I can obtain the mapped reaction SMILES and its template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic acid"]
}</action_input>
